arguments.command:
cd /tmp && python -c "
from glom import Fill, Auto, Iter, Let, ROOT, Invoke, Check, Assign, Coalesce

# Test Fill repr
f = Fill('a', 'default')
print('Fill repr:', repr(f))

# Test Auto repr
a = Auto('a.b')
print('Auto repr:', repr(a))

# Test Iter repr
i = Iter('x')
print('Iter repr:', repr(i))

# Test Let repr
l = Let({'name': 'value'})
print('Let repr:', repr(l))

# Test ROOT repr
print('ROOT repr:', repr(ROOT))

# Test Invoke repr
inv = Invoke(lambda x: x, args=(1,), kwargs={'y': 2})
print('Invoke repr:', repr(inv))

# Test Check repr (existing)
c = Check(type=int)
print('Check repr:', repr(c))

# Test Assign repr (existing)
asgn = Assign(('a',), 1)
print('Assign repr:', repr(asgn))

# Test Coalesce repr (existing)
co = Coalesce('a', 'b')
print('Coalesce repr:', repr(co))
"
